hero.description: VectoryAI helps urban planners turn legacy zoning and master plans into accurate, editable GIS layers without tracing every boundary by hand.
hero.mapLabel: Abstract preview of an urban plan map
hero.caption: georeferenced plan preview

outcomes.kicker: Built for the work behind the map
outcomes.note: A focused workspace for municipalities, planning offices, and GIS teams managing the next revision.

workflow.kicker: A considered path from raster to vector

steps.title: Bring in the plan
steps.body: Upload a high-resolution PDF, TIFF, JPG, or PNG.

steps.title: Anchor it in EOV
steps.body: Place ground control points against a reference layer or the default OpenStreetMap view.

steps.title: Teach the legend
steps.body: Review detected markings, colors, and geometry types before the model starts tracing.

steps.title: Export clean layers
steps.body: Inspect the result, correct what matters, and download strict GIS-ready Shapefile layers.

closing.description: Digitize zoning districts, regulatory lines, and point symbols in one traceable workflow. Native EOV support included.
